requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous but contains concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into two separate artefacts per Pohl §25.2: one functional requirement for persistence and one quality requirement for feedback.

source_fragments: the system shall write the current document to disk

fields.condition: the user selects the Save option

structured_requirements.final_statement: When the user selects the Save option, the system shall write the current document to disk.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action (persistence) from the original mixed sentence.

fields.condition: after the document is written to disk

structured_requirements.final_statement: After the document is written to disk, the system shall display a confirmation message.
structuring_notes: Extracted the feedback action as a quality requirement to separate it from the persistence logic.
